bluf: Claneo is a Berlin based SEO, GEO and content marketing agency of 80+ experts selling to enterprise clients from ecommerce and retail to pharma and automotive. It is doing GEO: the H1 and meta name it, a GEO Know How Academy runs to episode 30, 72 AI search URLs sit in its sitemap, a GEO book is announced and 16 thought leader LinkedIn ads push SEO to GEO. Horus reads it Favored at +27, best placed for KJ1 and most exposed to KJ9. A rival should know: it sells AI visibility and publishes no llms.txt, lists no pricing, and 8 of its 17 named clients have no described work.
doing:
The positioning line, a Berlin based international agency for SEO, GEO and content marketing with 80+ experts, and the headline claim of a certified, multi award winning SEO agency with more than 80 experts, decode to a search specialist that has renamed its future GEO and sells headcount and certificates as proof; the BVDW SEO quality certificate, renewed per a 2025-02 news post, is the certificate.

The menu is search and content only: GEO & LLMO, KI-gestützte SEO-Lösungen, Suchmaschinenoptimierung, International SEO, Content Marketing, Content Creation, Digital PR, Offpage SEO, Shopsysteme, Perplexity SEO, AI Quick Check and Workshops. Three capabilities lead at score 3: AI Search / GEO (the H1 and meta name GEO; the GEO/LLMO page sells AI Quick Check, monitoring and workshops), Content & Digital PR (digital PR cases for MediaMarktSaturn, Jacasa, kaufDA, HelloFresh, Lieferando and Doctolib) and SEO (title and H1 lead with SEO; Buderus SEO and Henkel international SEO cases). AI Automation / Agents scores 2 on a KI-SEO page selling AI driven SEO consulting. Every other capability scores 0; breadth is 4. Proprietary items: AI Quick Check (a GEO entry audit), the GEO Know How Academy series, the State of Search Studie and EVI-800, a nav tool whose function is not shown. No partners are listed.

AI posture: GEO and LLMO lead, with AI visibility analysis and monitoring, GEO workshops, Perplexity SEO and AI assisted SEO processes. Moves: 2025-02, the BVDW certificate renewal; undated, a blog post announcing the first German language GEO book. No news items, case study text or job postings are on record.

Pricing: free, no obligation enquiry and consultation offers plus the AI Quick Check; the homepage FAQ covers SEO agency costs but the answer was not captured; P5 unknown. Conspicuously absent for a search agency of this size: a data or measurement line (score 0), feed, schema or entity work, a founding year, ownership, and any office beyond Berlin.

openings:
Lead with the contradiction on its lead line: Claneo sells AI visibility through AI Quick Check, monitoring and 72 AI-topic URLs, and publishes no llms.txt. A rival whose own house practises what it sells, bringing an audited citation share number, is likely, at moderate confidence, to beat the SEO to GEO pitch in a room where Claneo cannot show its own; the falsifier is llms.txt appearing on claneo.com.

The second opening is the layer it does not sell: P2 is absent, no feed, schema or entity work on a core search line, and Data & Measurement scores 0, so the KJ9 exposure (measurement gets worse before it gets better) is unhedged. An offer pairing entity and feed work with a measurement plan undercuts the hours Monsoon reads as most movable (SEO 24, Content & Digital PR 16). Pricing is the third: no public model, P5 unknown, a costs FAQ with no captured answer, so a transparent outcome priced offer is a conversation it cannot have. Contestable names: the 8 named only clients, and the digital PR book (Lieferando, Doctolib, HelloFresh, toom Baumarkt) if a rival can show earned media that AI answers cite.
